archetypes.name: dyn-hook-retry
archetypes.rationale: The changed dispatcher commit path must preserve hook-fixed bytes and exact teardown semantics across both attempts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 2 dispatcher commit retry as an integration boundary with client hooks. Verify the second stage adopts all hook edits, the retry is bounded to one attempt, and only final-command stderr survives failure. Check that success preserves both manifest paths and leaves no stale diagnostic. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
